claim: Human and DocAble comparison: per-document median checker reductions; increased-finding counts; semantic 20 better, 41 parity, 1 worse of 62; document-criterion gains and regressions. Undefined XLSX percentage preserved; parity is not accessibility equivalence.
alt: Human and DocAble comparison: per-document median checker reductions; increased-finding counts; semantic 20 better, 41 parity, 1 worse of 62; document-criterion gains and regressions. Undefined XLSX percentage preserved; parity is not accessibility equivalence.
caption: *Remediation compared with the human reference.* (a) Median reduction in checker findings from the original; (b) frequency of increased findings; (c) semantic comparison of DocAble and human outputs under the project rubric; (d) criterion-level gains and regressions relative to the original. DocAble led on PDF and DOCX checker reductions and image-description gains; the human workflow led on PPTX checker reductions. Parity denotes similar measured improvement, not equivalent accessibility. [short: Human-reference remediation results]
